entries.meaningZh: 紧身连衣裙的（服装术语）
entries.en: The dressmaker selected a princesse gown with panels running from the neckline to the hem.
entries.zh: 裁缝选择了一件衣片从领口延伸至裙摆的紧身长礼服。

entries.meaningZh: 安雅（美国女影星）
entries.en: After the screening, Anya answered questions about her role in the film.
entries.zh: 放映结束后，安雅回答了关于她在影片中所饰角色的问题。

entries.meaningZh: 粗黑体字（印刷术语）
entries.en: The printer set the warning in blackface so it would stand out on the page.
entries.zh: 印刷员把警告排成粗黑体字，使它在页面上更醒目。

entries.meaningZh: 法国一乐队名
entries.en: The record shop ordered another copy of the French band Ange's album after selling its last one.
entries.zh: 那家唱片店售出最后一张法国乐队Ange的专辑后，又订购了一张。

entries.meaningZh: 粘性物质（此处指污物；不得用于侮辱人）
entries.en: A layer of gook had collected around the drain, so we put on gloves before cleaning it.
entries.zh: 排水口周围积了一层黏糊糊的污物，所以我们先戴上手套才清理。

entries.meaningZh: (伊朗)议会
entries.en: The reporter waited outside the Majlis for the debate to end.
entries.zh: 记者在伊朗议会外等候辩论结束。

entries.meaningZh: 胆小鬼（带性别偏见的侮辱性称呼）
entries.en: The coach stopped the boy who had called his teammate a 'sissy' for refusing the jump.
entries.zh: 教练制止了那个因队友拒绝跳跃就骂其为“胆小鬼”的男孩。

entries.meaningZh: 达到目标或水平的人（原条指向 attain；此为所选施事名词义注释）
entries.en: The teacher paired each high attainer with a pupil who wanted extra practice.
entries.zh: 老师将每位成绩优异的学生与一位想多做练习的学生配成一组。

entries.meaningZh: 希尔伯特（此处指数学家 David Hilbert）
entries.en: The students compared two accounts of Hilbert's early mathematical work.
entries.zh: 学生们比较了两篇关于希尔伯特早期数学研究的记述。

entries.meaningZh: 指导者（此处指女童军的成年领队）
entries.en: The Guider checked that every girl had a torch before the evening walk.
entries.zh: 夜间步行活动前，女童军领队确认每个女孩都有手电筒。

entries.meaningZh: 蒙罗维亚（利比里亚首都）
entries.en: The courier left the documents in Monrovia before continuing inland.
entries.zh: 快递员把文件留在蒙罗维亚，然后继续向内陆行进。

entries.meaningZh: 相互关联（原条指向 interrelated；此为所选名词义注释）
entries.en: The diagram makes the interrelatedness of the three supply chains easier to see.
entries.zh: 这张图使三条供应链之间的相互关联更容易看清。

entries.meaningZh: 取代（有争议且常被视为错误的拼法；规范形式为 supersede）
entries.en: The old notice read, 'These instructions supercede all earlier notices.'
entries.zh: 旧告示上写着：“这些指示取代此前所有告示。”

entries.meaningZh: 苏菲（旧时对波斯君主的称号，现已过时）
entries.en: In the old travel narrative, the envoy waited three days for an audience with the Sophy.
entries.zh: 在那篇旧旅行记中，使节为求见苏菲等了三天。

entries.meaningZh: 时髦（原条指向 hip；此处取当前父条形容词的状态名词义注释）
entries.en: The café relied on its hipness to attract customers, but the coffee was disappointing.
entries.zh: 那家咖啡馆靠时髦来吸引顾客，但咖啡令人失望。

entries.meaningZh: 鲁格尔手枪
entries.en: A Luger lay in the display case beside a handwritten inventory.
entries.zh: 展柜里放着一把鲁格尔手枪，旁边是一份手写清单。

entries.meaningZh: 愚笨的（非正式；此处形容想法）
entries.en: Building a cardboard castle on that windy beach was a daffy idea.
entries.zh: 在那片风大的海滩上搭纸板城堡，真是个愚蠢的主意。

entries.meaningZh: 一种操作系统
entries.en: The archivist set aside a separate folder for screenshots taken from NeXTSTEP.
entries.zh: 档案管理员专门留出一个文件夹，存放NeXTSTEP操作系统的屏幕截图。

entries.meaningZh: 祭仪的（原条指向 cult；此为所选礼拜、祭仪关系义注释）
entries.en: The archaeologist interpreted the figurine as a cultic object rather than a toy.
entries.zh: 考古学家将那尊小塑像解释为祭仪用品，而不是玩具。

entries.meaningZh: 索巴
entries.en: The truck delivered the supplies to Soba before the rain began.
entries.zh: 卡车在下雨前把物资送到了索巴。

entries.meaningZh: 通过内窥镜（原条指向 endoscopic；此为所选器械方式义注释）
entries.en: The team obtained the images endoscopically and added them to the report.
entries.zh: 团队用内窥镜获取了这些图像，并将其加入报告。
